Players Committee card image of [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]] (Virtual Set 13), as first published (no errata mark), printing: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to a battleground site as a regular move. Immune to attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1760f9c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/yodamasteroftheforce.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/yodamasteroftheforce.gif] as of commit 1760f9c “directory name change” (9 November 2020).
